brand.name: GEM.IQ
usage_rules: Use navy+mint standard logo on light surfaces.
Use white+mint (light) logo on dark surfaces.
Never invert, tint, or wrap the logo in a white pill.

copy.trial_line: Your trial includes one assessment. You'll see your score and tier; the full report unlocks when your plan starts.
copy.plans_line: Starter: one assessment. Growth: three assessments you choose, plus the combined report. Complete: all assessments, combined report and quarterly retakes.
copy.growth_rule: Growth covers the first three different assessments you take; to add more, upgrade to Complete.

capability.label: Capability diagnostics
capability.blurb: Maturity X-rays of the functions every company runs — go-to-market, sales, product, AI, and experience. Scored on the same 5-tier scale so results compare across disciplines.

specialist.label: Specialist diagnostics
specialist.blurb: Domain-specific diagnostics for companies with that exposure. Same rigour and the same tier scale, but the question is narrower — and the output is usually a dollar figure, not just a maturity level.

response.content_version: integer | null — Hub content version currently loaded

contracts.control_fields: control.global.notice, control.apps[<key>].paused/notice — read on boot and every 5 minutes
contracts.report_fields: report.apps[<key>]: sections (ordered, enabled), trial_access, copy (title_pattern, intro, disclaimer, closing_message, closing_cta, closing_url), tiers (key, label, min, color), mode (app | hub), benchmark (min_group, reference), roadmap_items. Section keys may grow (e.g. executive_summary, maturity, benchmark, roadmap, methodology); ignore keys you do not render. When mode = hub, link users to the submit response's report_url instead of rendering a report.

submit_extras.recommendations: string[] or { summary, strengths[], gaps[], recommendations[], next_steps[] } — optional; the Hub uses it in Hub-built reports
submit_extras.content_version: integer — the Hub content version used for this run (omit when using built-in questions); send answers as { questionKey: optionKey } so the Hub can re-check the score

content_endpoint.response: { key, version, published_at, content: { intro, sections[{key,title,description,weight,questions[{key,text,help,weight,options[{key,label,points}]}]}], tiers[{key,label,min}], tier_recommendations{tierKey: string[]} } } — 404 { version: null } when nothing is published

content_export.response: { content: <same shape as content_endpoint.content> } — the app's current built-in questions

contracts.composite_rule: weight = admin weight per live assessment (default 1, 0 excludes); combined score = weighted average of each completed live assessment's latest score, rounded; stage = highest combined tier with min <= score, shown only once completed >= min_for_tier; next = highest-weighted live assessment not yet completed
contracts.methodology: Optional content fields: methodology { summary, frameworks[], comparison, references[{ title, url? }] }, sections[].rationale and questions[].rationale ("Why we ask this"). Show them when present. Hub-wide methodology: /methodology.
contracts.scoring_rule: question = chosen option points (0-100); section = weighted average of answered questions (question.weight); overall = weighted average of answered sections (section.weight), rounded; tier = highest tier with min <= overall
